verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is a self-hosted AI platform, not purely an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only shows MCP client support: Open WebUI can call tools from external MCP servers. Nothing shows Open WebUI exposing its own MCP server for outside agents to connect to. The gateway API is OpenAI-compatible, not MCP, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
